campaign: statistical-vs-model decomposition of the channel u+ error
note: Thresholds are transcribed from the node goal; they are NOT tuned to the data. The runs were launched with these arms before this file was written (the analysis had not been executed). Any threshold change must be recorded as an amendment with a reason.

target_number_under_decomposition.quantity: relative L2 of the folded u+ profile vs MKM-1999 Re_tau=180

LAM_yw.role: laminar twin at the production viscosity, measures y_w

gates.criterion: 95 % batch-means CI half-width of u+ <= 3 % (max over the comparison window y+ in [10,170])
relative L2 difference between Lx=2 pi delta and Lx=4 pi delta u+ profiles (same grid) <= 3 %
binary verdict from U_SN: residual_beyond_ci = error - U_SN compared to the 3 % scale; model/domain dominated if exceeded, statistics dominated otherwise
max |u+_{Cs=0.1} - u+_{Cs=0}| > combined 95 % CI of the pair
err(T_obs) curve with >= 2 windows, fitted exponent, and the MKM-box machine-time forecast

fail_closed_rules: averaging window < 3 eddy turnovers (delta/u_tau) -> G_B withheld (degradation rule of the node)
no stable cumulant operating point -> G_E withheld
